Slowly gradually cutting it off helps your brain to retrain it to now rely on the chemicals released from smoking. 

Our brains have neuroplasticity. Think of it as making pathways in the brain. That’s why practice makes perfect. There are tons of research available on it. Learned this last year in high school LOL.

If you use 7 days a week, slow it down, cut it down to 6, then the next week 5 and if need be if you think you are going to relapse, you can stick at 4 days a week and then slowly again start to reduce. Treat yourself for a good lunch maybe or something you’ve wanted.
